decks.notes: The main focus of this deck is utilizing control elements to disrupt opponents and protect key cards, while also having access to card draw and removal. The deck aims to control the board using counterspells, removal spells, and card advantage, allowing the player to stabilize and take control of the game. The win condition revolves around efficient creatures like Gurmag Angler and Fallaji Archaeologist, alongside disruption from Unexpected Fangs and Spell Pierce. It also contains card filtering and graveyard synergies to maintain consistency and leverage powerful spells.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game through the use of various gate cards and counterspells. By utilizing cards like Citadel Gate and Prismatic Strands, the deck is able to hinder opponent's strategies while setting up its own win conditions. The inclusion of cards like Oblivion Ring and Journey to Nowhere allows for removal of key threats on the board. Additionally, the deck includes cards that provide card advantage and card selection, giving the player the tools needed to outmaneuver their opponent and secure victory.

The deck focuses on leveraging artifact synergy to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and efficient removal spells. By utilizing cards like Myr Enforcer and Frogmite, along with cheap artifacts like Chromatic Star and Ichor Wellspring, the deck aims to flood the board with threats while disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Galvanic Blast and Metallic Rebuke. The inclusion of sacrificial outlets like Makeshift Munitions and Deadly Dispute further enhances the deck's ability to maintain pressure and close out games efficiently.

This deck focuses on quickly building up one or two powerful creatures with auras to overwhelm the opponent. By using cards like Slippery Bogle, Ethereal Armor, and Armadillo Cloak, the goal is to create a huge threat that is difficult for the opponent to deal with. Cards like Utopia Sprawl and Abundant Growth help to fix mana and keep the deck running smoothly. The key strategy is to be aggressive and put pressure on the opponent early on, using auras to enhance creatures and win the game quickly.

The main focus of this UR Control deck is to efficiently control the game through counterspells and removal spells while also utilizing card advantage and tempo plays. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy with counterspells like Counterspell and Spell Pierce, while also applying pressure with creatures like Ninja of the Deep Hours and Faerie Seer. The inclusion of cards like Skred and Lightning Bolt allows the deck to handle threats on the board, while cards like Ponder and Brainstorm help dig for key cards. Ultimately, the deck looks to outvalue and outmaneuver opponents in a Pauper 1 vs 1 format.

The main focus of this Dimir Control deck is to utilize a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and card draw to control the game and outvalue the opponent. The deck includes powerful threats like Gurmag Angler to close out games, along with efficient card draw spells like Deep Analysis and Thought Scour to maintain card advantage. The deck also utilizes lands like Contaminated Aquifer and Ice Tunnel to fix its mana base. Overall, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while generating advantage to ultimately secure victory.

The deck focuses on aggressive creature strategies in black and white, aiming to quickly overwhelm the opponent with a combination of efficient removal spells and powerful creatures. With a mix of lifelink creatures, flyers, and anthems to boost the team, the Orzhov Aggro deck aims to control the board and chip away at the opponent's life total until victory is achieved. The inclusion of cards like Ephemerate and Inspiring Overseer provide additional value and flexibility in combat, making it a versatile and powerful deck in the pauper format.

This control deck focuses on assembling the Urzatron lands (Urza's Tower, Power Plant, and Mine) to generate a large amount of mana quickly. The deck includes a variety of spells to control the board, draw cards, generate more mana, and eventually win the game through various win conditions such as attacking with creatures like Mulldrifter or using Rolling Thunder to deal damage to the opponent. The deck also includes cards like Moment's Peace and Stonehorn Dignitary to stall the game and protect itself while it sets up its powerful mana base.

The main idea of this deck is to quickly overwhelm your opponent with a fast and aggressive playstyle. By utilizing low-cost creatures and burn spells, your goal is to inflict damage on your opponent as quickly as possible, before they have a chance to establish their own strategy. Cards like Monastery Swiftspear and Experimental Synthesizer help you build momentum early on, while spells like Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning provide additional direct damage. This deck aims to finish the game swiftly and decisively, relying on speed and efficiency to secure victory.

This deck focuses on aggressive plays using low-cost creatures and burn spells to quickly damage the opponent's life total. By utilizing cards like Galvanic Blast, Lightning Bolt, and Fiery Temper, the deck aims to keep the pressure on the opponent and end the game quickly. Vampire's Kiss and Alms of the Vein provide additional life gain to help sustain the aggressive strategy. The inclusion of cards like Faithless Looting and Drossforge Bridge allows for card draw and additional synergy within the deck. Overall, this deck is designed to overwhelm the opponent with fast, efficient threats.

The main concept of this deck is to take advantage of the Affinity mechanic by playing artifact creatures and generating value from sacrificing artifacts. The deck aims to swarm the board with cheap artifact creatures like Frogmite and Myr Enforcer while also using cards like Chromatic Star and Ichor Wellspring to draw cards and ramp up. Using cards like Deadly Dispute and Makeshift Munitions, the deck can sacrifice artifacts for additional value, while Galvanic Blast and Metallic Rebuke provide removal and disruption against the opponent.

The deck focuses on aggressively playing artifacts and creatures with affinity for artifacts, aiming to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of cheap spells, efficient threats, and card advantage. By utilizing various artifacts like Chromatic Star and Ichor Wellspring to power out powerful threats such as Myr Enforcer and Gurmag Angler, the deck can quickly build a board presence and close out games before the opponent has a chance to stabilize. With removal spells like Galvanic Blast and Chainer's Edict to control the opponent's board, the deck aims to outpace and outvalue the opponent in a fast-paced showdown.

The main focus of this Dimir Control deck is to disrupt your opponent's strategy while efficiently controlling the game. With a mix of counterspells, removal spells, and card draw, the deck aims to maintain card advantage and out-value the opponent. By utilizing powerful threats like Gurmag Angler and versatile spells like Thought Scour, the deck seeks to establish board control and close out the game with efficient finishers. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Unexpected Fangs and Suffocating Fumes provide additional utility and versatility to handle various matchups and situations.

The primary focus of this deck is to establish control through various removal spells, disrupting the opponent's strategy while generating value through card draw and recursion. By utilizing efficient removal like Lightning Bolt and Chainer's Edict, along with card advantage from Ichor Wellspring and Experimental Synthesizer, the deck aims to outvalue the opponent while maintaining board control. Additionally, the deck includes artifact synergies with cards like Galvanic Blast and Glint Hawk to further snowball its advantage. The mana base is optimized for consistency and allows for easy access to all necessary colors.

The main focus of this Dimir Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's strategy while also digging for key cards to gain advantage. The deck includes counterspells to stop threats, card draw like Deep Analysis and Brainstorm to find answers, and removal spells like Snuff Out to deal with creatures. Gurmag Angler provides a powerful threat while Contaminated Aquifer helps fix mana. Unexpected Fangs and Suffocating Fumes offer additional versatility in combat situations. The deck aims to control the game until it can establish dominance and win through card advantage and efficient removal.

This Pauper 1 vs 1 Aggro-Affinity deck focuses on quickly putting out artifact creatures like Myr Enforcer and using cheap removal spells like Galvanic Blast to deal damage to the opponent. The deck also includes card draw with Thoughtcast and ways to sacrifice artifacts for value with cards like Deadly Dispute and Makeshift Munitions. By utilizing efficient artifacts and synergy between cards, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a quick and aggressive strategy, making the most out of the Affinity mechanic to achieve victory.
